item.title: Build Your Corporate Second Brain with AI
item.description: A corporate second brain keeps track of what happens in your company: emails, chat messages, prospects, proposals, invoices, the status of every project. It gives that material back when you need it, and it shows what is going wrong and what has become urgent, so you keep the whole picture in view. It also recognizes when a new situation resembles an old one, finds the solution that worked last time, and stops you repeating a mistake you have already made.
